title: A pop-declared impression is filled with plain banner HTML instead of a redirect script
specRef: packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js — admLooksLikePop / bid.pop.adm_not_redirect, documented against oRTB 2.6 §3.2.4 Object:Imp extensibility (imp.ext.adtype pop-family hint)

response.value: NOT A REDIRECT — PLAIN BANNER MARKUP

specNotes: This case demonstrates a format-mismatch check that already works: the pop-response plugin's per-bid gate is satisfied because bid.ext.adtype='popunder' is unchanged from the base fixture, so admLooksLikePop(bid.adm) is evaluated against the new plain-HTML adm, finds none of its three accepted redirect shapes (bare URL / window.open / location redirect), and reports bid.pop.adm_not_redirect at ERROR.

The crosscheck pop-landing rule (3d-pop) is a separate, silently-skipped check here: extractPopLandingHost(adm) finds no host to extract from plain HTML, so neither crosscheck.bid.pop.adomain_landing_match nor _mismatch fires — that silence is itself the documented behavior (packages/core/crosscheck.js:395-408 comment), not a gap being asserted by this case.

bid.w/bid.h are absent on this bid (as in the base fixture), so crosscheck's banner-size block never runs at all; the only signal that this fill is wrong is the response-side pop-response finding asserted above.
